checks.check: a fresh budget reports everything available
a reservation reduces what is available
a reservation is not yet usage
a second reservation cannot take budget already held
checks.detail: reserving 1 call(s) would exceed the budget: 0 remaining

checks.check: a reservation covering no calls is refused
checks.detail: a reservation must cover at least one call

checks.check: settling charges what the call actually used, not what was reserved
settling twice on one reservation is refused
a provider-quality settlement without a figure is refused
checks.detail: a provider-quality settlement must supply the provider's token count

checks.check: the refused settlement leaves the ledger exactly as it was
the reservation is still open and settles normally afterwards
settling an unknown reservation is refused
releasing returns the reservation to the pool
a released reservation is not usage
releasing an unknown reservation is refused
a reservation cannot hold a negative token count
checks.detail: a reservation cannot hold a negative token count

checks.check: a negative finalization reserve is refused
checks.detail: the finalization reserve must be between 0 and the whole token budget

checks.check: a negative call ceiling is refused
a negative settled count is refused rather than credited
checks.detail: a settled token count cannot be negative

checks.check: the refused negative settlement left the reservation open
an unrecognised usage quality is refused, not silently downgraded
checks.detail: unknown usage quality 'PROVIDER'; expected one of ('provider', 'estimated', 'unknown')

checks.check: a call with no provider figure settles at its estimate, never at zero
an unmeasured call is labelled unknown rather than provider
the run's quality is as weak as its weakest call
a run mixing provider and estimated measurement reports the weaker
a full ordinary share and the reserve can both be held (finalization first)
a full ordinary share and the reserve can both be held (ordinary first)
ordinary work does not see the finalization reserve
ordinary work cannot spend past its share
checks.detail: reserving 900 token(s) would exceed the ordinary budget: 800 available

checks.check: finalization work cannot spend past the reserve
checks.detail: reserving 201 token(s) would exceed the finalization budget: 200 available

checks.check: a reserve larger than the whole budget is refused at construction
checks.detail: the finalization reserve must be between 0 and the whole token budget

checks.check: a settlement larger than its reservation surfaces as an overrun
work may reserve before the deadline
work is refused once the deadline has passed (section 10)
a run with no deadline is never refused for time

scope: pure budget ledger; no framework, no Runner, no model
note: every method is await-free, so check-then-reserve is atomic under asyncio
